## `label_replace` [promql-fn-label_replace]

{applies_to}`stack: ga 9.6`

:::{include} brief-summary/label_replace.md
:::

**Return type**

`instant_vector`

**Parameters**

`v` (`instant_vector`)
:   Instant vector input.

`dst_label` (`scalar`)
:   Name of the label to set.

`replacement` (`scalar`)
:   Replacement value, with `$1`/`$name`/`${name}` capture-group expansion.

`src_label` (`scalar`)
:   Name of the label to read.

`regex` (`scalar`)
:   Regular expression matched against `src_label`.

**Example**

```
sum by (job2) (label_replace(http_requests_total, "job2", "$1", "job", "(.*)-server"))
```

**Differences from Prometheus**

Supported in this version only when the derived destination label is consumed by an enclosing `by(...)` aggregation. The destination may be a new label or may overwrite a stored label (a dimension or `__name__`). It is also supported over the result of an enclosed `by(...)` aggregation (optionally under `topk`, `bottomk`, `limitk` or `limit_ratio`), as long as the destination is a new label {applies_to}`stack: ga 9.7+`. A `without` grouping, a binary operator, or a bare (non-aggregated) call over raw series is rejected. Regular expressions use the RE2 engine (RE2 syntax including `(?P<name>)`, `$1`/`$name`/`${name}` replacement expansion, no backreferences, fully anchored as `^(?s:regex)$`), matching Prometheus. Reading or overwriting `__name__` behaves like Prometheus only for Prometheus-style data that stores `__name__` as a label; for OpenTelemetry-style metrics the metric name is not exposed as a readable or writable label here.
